lede: Nebraska carries the stronger underlying team rating — +0.9 against -0.7, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan State -2.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan State winning 56% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Nebraska leads Michigan State by 114 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
